sources.title: Toolbox for the Modeling and Analysis of Thermodynamic Systems (T-MATS) User's Guide
sources.repository_policy: The public report PDF remains external to this repository. Extracted reference values and provenance are tracked here.

sources.title: AGTF30 MEX steady-state solver and linearization tool

reference_case.description: T-MATS and NPSS steady design-point comparison using the same public maps and constants
reference_case.published_interpretation: The report states that the listed T-MATS and NPSS steady-state differences are below 0.5 percent.

declared_assumptions: The total station-2 air flow is split into 0.768 N2 and 0.232 O2 mass fractions for the Cantera material basis.
Published compressor torque is converted to shaft power at the published 10000 rpm; it is not an independently tabulated power measurement.
The T-MATS source map and its three published scaler values are inputs, not fitted Thermox parameters.

acceptance.criterion: Absolute relative error below 0.5 percent for station-3 pressure, station-3 temperature, and shaft power inferred from compressor torque.

agtf30_off_design_execution.selection: Five converged rows with nominal health parameters and zero sensor/actuator biases; the degraded-health and biased-sensor rows are excluded.
agtf30_off_design_execution.bleed_model: A generic instance-sized fractional-bleed port group reproduces the three declared AGTF30 extractions and their pressure/enthalpy state fractions; no case-specific correction is fitted.

agtf30_hpt_inverse_map_execution.selection: The same five converged nominal-health, zero-bias operating points used for the HPC slice.
reserved_comparisons: HPT outlet temperature until combustor product composition replaces the declared simplified N2/O2 boundary.
Net HP-shaft balance until compressor, combustor, turbine, and power extraction are connected.

agtf30_coupled_high_spool_execution.chemistry: agtf30_major_products.yaml; seven-species methane-air HP equilibrium using GRI-Mech 3.0 thermodynamic species data
agtf30_coupled_high_spool_execution.boundary_contract: Station 25 state and flow, HP shaft speed, and 350 hp extraction are fixed. Fuel flow, station 4, turbine pressure ratio, and station 45 are solved.
reserved_comparisons: Fuel-flow predictive qualification: Thermox solves 12.01 to 12.77 percent below the T-MATS command and no calibration is applied.
Independent hardware validation and whole-engine net-thrust/nozzle performance.

agtf30_coupled_low_spool_execution.selection: The same five converged nominal-health, zero-bias operating points used for the HPC, HPT, and coupled high-spool slices.
agtf30_coupled_low_spool_execution.boundary_contract: Station 2 pressure/temperature and the NASA-solved fan R-line are fixed; fan flow is reconstructed from the source map. Station 23 flow/state, station 48 pressure/temperature, LPT exit cooling state/flow, and N2 speed are fixed. LPT main flow is relaxed and solved from map compatibility plus LP-shaft closure.
agtf30_coupled_low_spool_execution.topology: A generic geared two-load shaft train connects the LPT driver to a direct LPC load and a fan load at N2/3.1, with declared shaft efficiency 0.99 and gearbox efficiency 1.0.
reserved_comparisons: Continuous gas-path prediction: the splitter, core/bypass ducts, variable bleed valve, and nozzles are not connected in this station-sliced declaration.
Independent fan R-line prediction: NASA's solved R-line substitutes for the downstream gas-path constraint omitted from this slice.

agtf30_continuous_twin_spool_execution.selection: Four healthy nominal cases whose NASA variable-bleed-valve command is zero; the sea-level-static case is reserved because its command is nonzero.
agtf30_continuous_twin_spool_execution.boundary_contract: Station 2 pressure/temperature, N1/N2 shaft speeds, published bypass ratio, fuel temperature, and 350 hp HP extraction are fixed. Total inlet flow, fan map coordinate, fuel flow, intermediate station states, and both turbine pressure ratios are solved.
agtf30_continuous_twin_spool_execution.topology: A continuous material graph connects fan, controlled core/bypass split, LPC, three-bleed HPC, equilibrium combustor, two-injection HPT, and one-injection LPT. Generic HP and geared LP shaft trains close simultaneously.
omitted_source_physics: Mach-dependent core and bypass duct pressure losses
core and bypass convergent nozzles and net thrust
reserved_comparisons: Fuel-flow predictive qualification: no case-specific calibration is applied to the retained 15.66 to 16.09 percent cross-model difference.
Whole-engine flow/thrust prediction until duct, variable-bleed-valve, and nozzle constraints are connected.
Whole-engine flow and thrust until core/bypass nozzles close both terminal paths.
The nonzero-VBV point until a generic VBV is connected.
Fuel prediction, independent hardware validation, and transient validation.

agtf30_nozzle_closed_twin_spool_executio.boundary_contract: Station 2 pressure/temperature, LP speed, VAFN area, ambient pressure, fuel temperature, and 350 hp extraction are fixed. Inlet flow, both compressor coordinates, bypass ratio, fuel, HP speed, both turbine pressure ratios, and all downstream states are solved.
agtf30_nozzle_closed_twin_spool_executio.source_nozzle_contract: Two convergent nozzles; source Cd=1, bypass Cfg=0.9975, core Cfg=0.9999, core throat=393.43 in2, and case-scheduled bypass VAFN area.
reserved_comparisons: Net thrust until ambient/inlet ram drag is connected.
Sea-level-static nonzero-VBV point until a generic VBV is connected.
Fuel-flow predictive qualification, independent hardware evidence, and transient validation.

interpretation_limit: These tests validate deterministic import, coordinate-map interpolation, off-design thermochemistry, bleed/cooling routing, duct loss, nozzle capacity, and exact two-shaft conservation against public NASA code paths. They are not independent hardware validation, nonzero-VBV validation, net-thrust qualification, fuel-flow predictive qualification, or transient validation.
